description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android app called BudgetBuddy. It sets up a bottom navigation view and manages switching between Dashboard, Add Expense, and Reports fragments based on user interaction.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting the app's primary UI, setting up bottom navigation and fragment switching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up the bottom navigation listener. Loads the default Dashboard fragment when created.

methods.name: switchToFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment in the container with the provided fragment, updating the displayed content.
